name: Local Equilibrium Equation
description: Replaces a global sum of independent edge constraints with a system of local vertex constraints. For each vertex, a linear combination of its neighbors' values and its own value is constrained. Because the variables are restricted to the discrete domain {1, 2}, this local equation forces the sum of neighbors to an extreme bound, strictly requiring all neighbors to have the opposite value of the vertex. LLMs will likely attempt to solve it as a continuous linear system, use numeric relaxation, or fail to deduce the discrete bounding argument needed to map it to graph coloring.
